name: Orbital Economy v7.5 Capital Goods candidate r1
description: v7.5 Capital Goods / kernel-v2 candidate r1: local equipment sector in A/B physically backs Refinery, Electronics and Power expansion. Modes 0-20 switch it off for exact regression.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.5 master switch: capital expansion is fulfilled from locally produced capital goods.

add_elements.name: Metal per Capital Goods Unit
add_elements.description: Physical metal input per abstract capital-goods unit.

add_elements.name: Electronics per Capital Goods Unit
add_elements.description: Physical electronics input per abstract capital-goods unit.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Target Days
add_elements.description: Target inventory coverage for the capital-goods sector, in days of desired demand.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Adjustment Time
add_elements.description: First-order inventory correction time for desired capital-goods production.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Buffer
add_elements.description: Soft fulfillment buffer shared by all capital-consuming sectors in a colony.

add_elements.name: Test 22 Capital Goods Supply Shock Active

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 22, [Temporary Test Window], 0)

add_elements.description: Mode 22 temporary capital-goods production-capacity shock window.

add_elements.name: Test 23 Investment Boom Active

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 23, [Reverse Advantage Window], 0)

add_elements.description: Mode 23 sustained investment-boom demand shock from Test Shock Start Day onward.

add_elements.name: v7.5 Capital Goods Shock Multiplier
add_elements.description: Mode 22 multiplier applied to the selected colony capital-goods production capacity.

add_elements.name: v7.5 Investment Boom Multiplier
add_elements.description: Mode 23 multiplier applied to selected colony electronics local base demand.

add_elements.name: A Refinery Capital Goods per Capacity
add_elements.description: Capital-goods units consumed per unit of new A refinery installed capacity.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Capital Goods per Capacity
add_elements.description: Capital-goods units consumed per unit of new A electronics factory installed capacity.

add_elements.name: A Power Capital Goods per Capacity
add_elements.description: Capital-goods units consumed per unit of new A power generation installed capital.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Base Production Capacity
add_elements.description: Baseline production capacity of the A capital-goods sector.

add_elements.name: A Test 22 Capital Goods Shock Applies
add_elements.description: Applicability flag for Mode 22 capital-goods supply shock in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Test 23 Electronics Demand Applies
add_elements.description: Applicability flag for Mode 23 electronics demand shock in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Production Capacity

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Test 22 Capital Goods Supply Shock Active] = 1, [A Capital Goods Base Production Capacity] * IfThenElse([A Test 22 Capital Goods Shock Applies] = 1, [v7.5 Capital Goods Shock Multiplier], 1), [A Capital Goods Base Production Capacity])

add_elements.description: Effective A capital-goods production capacity after Mode 22 test wiring.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Inventory
add_elements.description: Local inventory of abstract capital goods in colony A; initial calibration value.

add_elements.name: A Refinery Desired Expansion

behavior.value: (([A Refinery Gap Limited Construction]) + ([A Refinery Finance Limited Construction]) - (((([A Refinery Gap Limited Construction]) - ([A Refinery Finance Limited Construction])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Unconstrained desired refinery expansion in colony A; verbatim accepted v7.4.1 expansion formula.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Desired Expansion

behavior.value: [Capital Lifecycle Enabled] * (([A Electronics Gap Limited Construction]) + ([A Electronics Finance Limited Construction]) - (((([A Electronics Gap Limited Construction]) - ([A Electronics Finance Limited Construction])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Unconstrained desired electronics expansion in colony A; verbatim accepted v7.4.1 expansion formula.

add_elements.name: A Power Desired Expansion

behavior.value: [Capital Lifecycle Enabled] * [A Power Gap Limited Construction]

add_elements.description: Unconstrained desired power expansion in colony A; verbatim accepted v7.4.1 expansion formula.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Demand

behavior.value: [A Refinery Desired Expansion] * [A Refinery Capital Goods per Capacity] + [A Electronics Desired Expansion] * [A Electronics Capital Goods per Capacity] + [A Power Desired Expansion] * [A Power Capital Goods per Capacity]

add_elements.description: Total desired local demand for capital goods generated by the three capital-expanding sectors in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Target Inventory

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Demand] * [Capital Goods Target Days]

add_elements.description: Target capital-goods inventory in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Desired Capital Goods Production

behavior.value: Max(0, [A Capital Goods Demand] + ([A Capital Goods Target Inventory] - [A Capital Goods Inventory]) / [Capital Goods Adjustment Time])

add_elements.description: Desired capital-goods production in colony A, including inventory correction.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Production Rate

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [A Desired Capital Goods Production] / (1 + ([A Desired Capital Goods Production] / ([A Capital Goods Production Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125 * [A Metal Inventory] / ([A Metal Inventory] + [A Metal Buffer]) * [A Electronics Inventory] / ([A Electronics Inventory] + [A Electronics Buffer]), 0)

add_elements.description: Actual A capital-goods production rate after capacity and input-inventory soft constraints.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Fulfillment

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [A Capital Goods Inventory] / ([A Capital Goods Inventory] + [Capital Goods Buffer]), 1)

add_elements.description: Common capital-goods fulfillment factor applied proportionally to all three expanding sectors in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Refinery Capital Goods Expansion Ratio

behavior.value: [A Refinery Expansion] / Max([A Refinery Desired Expansion], 0.000000001)

add_elements.description: Diagnostic ratio of actual to desired refinery expansion for v7.5 capital-goods tests.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Production

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Production Rate]

add_elements.description: Production of local capital goods in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Metal Consumption

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Production Rate] * [Metal per Capital Goods Unit]

add_elements.description: Metal physically consumed to produce capital goods in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Electronics Consumption

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Production Rate] * [Electronics per Capital Goods Unit]

add_elements.description: Electronics physically consumed to produce capital goods in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Refinery Capital Goods Consumption

behavior.value: [A Refinery Expansion] * [A Refinery Capital Goods per Capacity]

add_elements.description: Capital goods consumed by refinery expansion in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Capital Goods Consumption

behavior.value: [Capital Lifecycle Enabled] * [A Electronics Factory Expansion] * [A Electronics Capital Goods per Capacity]

add_elements.description: Capital goods consumed by electronics factory expansion in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Power Capital Goods Consumption

behavior.value: [Capital Lifecycle Enabled] * [A Power Generation Expansion] * [A Power Capital Goods per Capacity]

add_elements.description: Capital goods consumed by power generation expansion in colony A.

add_scenarios.name: v7.5 Capital Goods Baseline
add_scenarios.description: Coupled economy with capital goods enabled. Refinery, Electronics and Power expansion in both colonies consume locally produced capital goods.

add_scenarios.name: v7.5 Capital Goods Supply Shock
add_scenarios.description: Capital-goods sector enabled. Colony A capital-goods production capacity is multiplied by 0.3 from day 360 through 720; B remains unshocked.

add_scenarios.name: v7.5 Investment Boom
add_scenarios.description: Capital-goods sector enabled. Colony A electronics local demand is multiplied by 4 from day 360 onward, creating simultaneous capital-goods demand from expansion.
